title: Durable governed execution, delegation, reconciliation, managed delivery, evidence closeout, goal-filtered intelligence, and T141 canary readiness

phases.objective: Prove governed managed PR and release delivery, evidence closeout, goal-filtered operational intelligence, and non-mutating T141 canary readiness through executable synthetic-runtime journeys without force push, protected-branch bypass, secret exposure, provider mutation, or automatic mutation retry after an unknown outcome.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: executeManagedDeliveryLifecycle with reviewed repository intent, exact branch and pull-request identity, durable operation authority, approvals, and synthetic provider readbacks
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The lifecycle reaches terminal success only after exact-head delivery, governed reconciliation, approved merge authority, branch cleanup, deployment receipt, and Production parity readback are all bound to one immutable receipt chain; stale, ambiguous, or unauthorized paths fail closed without force push, protected-branch bypass, or duplicate mutation.
steps: Validate stable semantic anchors, exact blob identities, branch and pull-request identity, capability envelopes, and no-secret input.
Delegate preview and execution through the durable pr_delivery repository authority rather than raw Git or caller-supplied HTTP.
Detect stale nonterminal runs, cancel only the governed superseded operation, and bind replacement work to the current exact head.
Reconcile base drift through the governed branch-reconcile authority with normal non-force updates and exact readback.
Permit at most one structured low-risk delegated CI repair and reject unstructured, unrelated, or privileged changes.
Require a fresh approval bound to the final pull-request head and base SHAs immediately before merge.
Verify merge, branch absence, deployment receipt, Production parity, and the complete receipt chain before terminal success.
assertions: Line-number anchors, stale fingerprints, secret-like input, protected feature heads, force push, branch-protection bypass, and admin override are rejected.
Managed delivery reuses durable operation runs and receipts rather than introducing an untracked mutation path.
A changed head or base invalidates prior approval and blocks merge until a new exact-head approval exists.
Unknown or ambiguous mutation outcomes are reconciled by reads and are not followed by automatic duplicate writes.
Terminal success requires merge, verified branch absence, deployment receipt, and Production parity on the same immutable merge identity.

The certification uses synthetic repository and provider adapters and performs no real merge, branch deletion, deployment, Production mutation, provider write, database mutation, or secret disclosure.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: executeEvidenceAutoCloseout with reviewed evidence readers, exact repository blobs, semantic closeout intent, typed confirmation, and mutation approval
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A bounded closeout branch and pull request are considered created only after authoritative evidence validation, semantic five-document change generation, atomic patch readback, exact PR head/base readback, and no-force/no-secret checks; unknown mutation outcomes remain reconciliation-required without automatic retry.
steps: Collect exactly one fresh immutable observation for every required authoritative evidence family and calculate a deterministic evidence fingerprint.
Generate evidence-bound JSON Pointer and unique Markdown-anchor mutations for manifest, completion, checklist, tasks, and delivery-state documents.
Validate blob identities, content digests, semantic operations, JSON parseability, completion truthfulness, bounded size, and structured failure diagnosis before repository commit.
Preview the repository change through the durable pr_delivery path, then simulate atomic repo_patch_batch_apply with exact branch-head and changed-path readback.
Simulate github_create_pull_request followed by github_get_pull_request and verify the open PR number, head branch, exact head SHA, and base branch.

Simulate unknown patch and PR-create outcomes, perform readback once, and prove that no automatic mutation retry, force push, protected-branch bypass, Production write, provider write, deployment, or secret exposure occurs.
assertions: Missing, duplicate, stale, mutable, failed, unrelated, ambiguous, or secret-like evidence cannot produce a closeout change set.
Every task and checklist closure references evidence contained in the validated authoritative packet.
Terminal completion is rejected unless all tasks plus migration-ledger, Production-parity, and post-merge-audit evidence are present.
The generated change set covers only the five governed document kinds and carries exact expected blob SHA plus before and after SHA-256 contracts.
Repository mutation is represented by repo_patch_batch_apply with force and force_push false and exact readback required.
Pull request creation uses registered GitHub endpoint authority and exact readback rather than caller-supplied raw HTTP authority.
An unknown mutation outcome is reconciled by reads and is never followed by an automatic repeated write.
The certification performs no real repository write, real PR creation, Production mutation, provider write, deployment, runtime authority activation, protected-branch bypass, or secret disclosure.

e2e_journeys.actor: Admin or Tenant operator inspecting one governed goal
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: buildGoalFilteredOperationalIntelligence with a stable goal descriptor, durable operation snapshots, subject-scoped Activation operational intelligence, and a governed diagnostic reference registrar
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A bounded summary-first projection reports the goal state, linked operations, blockers, next actions, and blocking, related-risk, and platform-wide attention while preserving complete diagnostics for every linked and unrelated operation and attention item through verified governed references.
steps: Normalize the goal and require at least one exact operation, resource, container, workspace, Brand, system, or tag correlation anchor.

Correlate durable operation snapshots using explicit goal references, exact resource identities, compatible parent-child relations, and operation-key plus tag pairs while rejecting tenant-only linkage.
Load the subject-scoped Activation operational attention queue and classify every item as blocking, related_risk, platform_wide, or unrelated.
Register complete operation and attention payloads, including unrelated items, through a governed diagnostic registrar with exact SHA-256 readback.
Produce a bounded summary containing only linked operation and relevant attention summaries, counts, blockers, next actions, source health, and governed diagnostic references.

Exercise degraded-source, invalid-registrar, secret-input, no-operation, and inline-boundary cases without provider calls, external mutations, Production writes, deployment, or runtime authority changes.
assertions: An explicit goal reference creates a primary operation link and exact resource or compatible parent-child evidence creates supporting links.
Matching only the Tenant does not link an operation to the goal.
Every attention item receives exactly one of blocking, related_risk, platform_wide, or unrelated.
Direct goal relationships take precedence over platform-wide scope and unrelated items are counted but never inlined.
The inline projection respects configured item and byte limits and never includes raw operation or attention evidence.
Every operation and attention item has a governed reference whose digest matches the complete registered payload.
Degraded Activation sources remain visible and never become implicit successful evidence.
The projection is read-only and performs no provider call, external mutation, Production write, deployment, runtime authority change, or secret disclosure.

phases.objective: Exercise authorized non-production managed delivery, evidence closeout, goal-filtered intelligence, and T141 canary readiness against durable repository, operation, Activation, diagnostic-reference, migration-ledger, and runtime-binding authorities with exact readback.

Prove recovery from stale evidence, concurrent branch movement, duplicate delivery, partial readback, degraded operational surfaces, ambiguous goal relationships, stale T141 authorization, and upstream timeouts without duplicate mutation or diagnostic loss.

Run one governed non-production managed-delivery lifecycle, one evidence closeout, one goal-filtered operational projection, and one separately authorized T141 staging canary with complete receipts, diagnostic references, and bounded evidence while T141 remains open.

Use separately authorized Production migration, delegation-canary, deployment, and readback evidence while preserving provider, protected-branch, Tenant, runtime-policy, and diagnostic disclosure boundaries.
